title: Calendar
subtitle: Your channel's videos: published, scheduled and awaiting review.
automationHint: A scheduled automation in Flow; it is not changed here.
fillHint: Put one of your approved clips at this time.
dragHint: Drag to another day to reschedule
pastDay: A video cannot be moved to a past day.
emptyWeek: No videos on the calendar this week. Start by filling an empty strong slot.
emptyMonth: No videos on the calendar this month.
